notes.title: 🎮 Update Announcement: “I Have -No- Friends” 🎮
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J7BvuMy.png[/img]

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]

🤖 [b]Bots, Bots, Bots:[/b] Challenge yourself against our added AI opponents.

🧠 [b]Solo Play:[/b] Want to practice your skills while your friends are occupied with less important tasks like work or study? Hop in a match with your new robot buddies!

🪄 [b]Flexible Gameplay:[/b] Mix and match with human and AI players for a unique experience every time.

💡[b]Fill Slots:[/b] Struggling to balance those 5-player matches? Contemplating ending a friendship just to achieve an even number of players in your games? Now you can fill those slots with bots!

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

Take a glimpse of 4 bots against each other!  👀
